extracted.name: Vegan Caesar Dressing
extracted.description: This dairy-free, vegan Caesar dressing recipe is creamy, tangy, and SO easy to make! Try it on a classic Caesar salad, other simple salads, roasted veggies, or a grain bowl. Find more serving suggestions in the post above.
instruction_lines: In a high-speed blender, place the cashews, garlic, lemon juice, mustard, capers, water, and several grinds of pepper.
Blend until smooth and season to taste.
